doc: See docs/research/wing-edit-schema.md for the format description.

hash.input: getPath() text without its first char, e.g. 'ch.1.flt.lcf' for /ch/1/flt/lcf; ASCII a-z upper-cased, spaces skipped
hash.notes: 4 chars packed big-endian per block (k=(k<<8)|c); the trailing partial block gets the full block mix (incl. rotl13,*5+0xe6546b64); final h ^= nchars; no fmix. Reference: tools/schema-extract/winghash.py
